newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound one-week rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound one-week rates steady.

text.p: Private sector bankers said there was no overnight interbank borrowing on the Egyptian pound on Monday and one week rate were steady in a liquid market at between 10 5/16 and 10 3/8 percent.
"There was no interest in overnight dealings because of expected liquidity from T-bills maturing within the coming couple of days," the bankers said.
On Sunday, overnight rates ranged between 10 1/8 and 10 1/4 percent. Public-sector banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rate at 10 1/2 percent.
